title: Sloth holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- branch -->
  <rect x='5' y='78' width='90' height='8' rx='4' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <rect x='5' y='78' width='90' height='3' rx='2' fill='#A87550'/>
  <!-- sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#9B7B4F'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#C9A96E'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='55' rx='8' ry='14' fill='#8A6A40' transform='rotate(20 28 55)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='55' rx='8' ry='14' fill='#8A6A40' transform='rotate(-20 72 55)'/>
  <!-- claws left arm -->
  <rect x='21' y='66' width='3' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#E8D5A8'/>
  <rect x='25' y='67' width='3' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#E8D5A8'/>
  <rect x='29' y='66' width='3' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#E8D5A8'/>
  <!-- claws right arm -->
  <rect x='68' y='66' width='3' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#E8D5A8'/>
  <rect x='72' y='67' width='3' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#E8D5A8'/>
  <rect x='76' y='66' width='3' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#E8D5A8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#B08D5E'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#E0C99A'/>
  <!-- eye patches (dark but lit) -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='38' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#5B4A6E'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='38' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#5B4A6E'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#2E2440'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#2E2440'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='37' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='37' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#4A3828'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 49 Q50 53 55 49' stroke='#4A3828' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='34' r='4' fill='#B08D5E'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='34' r='4' fill='#B08D5E'/>
  <!-- heart held between arms -->
  <path d='M50 72 C50 72 40 62 40 68 C40 72 47 78 50 80 C53 78 60 72 60 68 C60 62 50 72 50 72 Z' fill='#E8556D'/>
  <path d='M50 72 C50 72 43 65 43 68.5 C43 71 47 75 50 77 C53 75 57 71 57 68.5 C57 65 50 72 50 72 Z' fill='#FF7A8A'/>
  <!-- top of branch leaves -->
  <ellipse cx='15' cy='76' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#4A8C3F' transform='rotate(-20 15 76)'/>
  <ellipse cx='85' cy='76' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#4A8C3F' transform='rotate(20 85 76)'/>
</svg>
